Frequently asked

Interview scheduling software automates the process of coordinating interviews between candidates, recruiters, and hiring teams. Instead of managing availability through back-and-forth emails, recruiters can use interview scheduling software to share available times, let candidates self-schedule, and keep interviews moving with less manual work.
Automated interview scheduling connects candidate invitations with interviewer availability, so candidates can select an open time without a recruiter coordinating every calendar. With Hirevue, candidates can receive an invitation by email or SMS, choose an available interview time and reschedule when needed.
Recruiters can schedule interviews faster by automating repetitive coordination such as checking calendars, sending invitations, confirming interview times, and managing rescheduling. An automated interview scheduler gives candidates more control while reducing the administrative work required from recruiting teams.
The best interview scheduling software should support candidate self-scheduling, automated reminders, calendar integrations, easy rescheduling, and more complex hiring workflows. For enterprise hiring teams, it should also be able to support multiple roles, interviewers, locations, and high-volume hiring events without creating another disconnected process.
Yes. Hirevue allows candidates to select available interview times and reschedule when necessary. Giving candidates the ability to manage their own interview time can reduce scheduling delays while creating a simpler experience for both candidates and recruiters.
Yes. Hirevue interview scheduling can support everything from individual interviews to hiring events involving multiple candidates, roles, and interviewers. Recruiters can define availability in advance and allow candidates to select from available times, helping teams manage high-volume recruiting without manually coordinating every interview.
